name: Reaper Spirit Render grants spell penetration (#2156)
contract: Spirit Render 570338 reads 'Increases your spell penetration by ${-($m1+0)}, scaling with your level.'
Spell.dbc gives it a single effect: aura 123 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE), MiscValue 126 (all magic schools), BasePoints -21, EffectRealPointsPerLevel -0.5, TargetA caster.
SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE is native and generic (AuraEffect::HandleModTargetResistance); the same aura backs the already-working #651 Forbidden Power spell-penetration clause.

Negative amount is spell penetration (Unit::CalcAbsorbResist subtracts the caster's own MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE total from the victim's resistance). At level 80 the level-scaled amount must be at least as negative as the raw -21 base.

steps.label: Fixture precondition: aura absent before learning
Spirit Render grants spell penetration (negative target-resistance amount)
